lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance white spots are visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in semi-regular vertical columns along the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the spots, creating a discernible grid-like pattern on the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear ridges are visible running along the upper third of the flank, displaying a sharp vertical intensity gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadows on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple high-contrast commensal fish (remoras) attached or swimming in close proximity to the ventral-pectoral region.
